summary_en: Uses obliquely superposed two-dimensional bottle-sheet beams to synthesize a ring-shaped acoustic pressure distribution on a target plane with airborne ultrasonic phased arrays. Numerical and physical experiments validate the ring field. The work is relevant to acoustic field shaping and holography-adjacent methods, but it is not an acoustic imaging or image-reconstruction paper.
